fr_html: Donc, maintenant qu'on a décidé que le Conseil et l'Assemblée voteront séparément ou indépendamment l'un de l'autre, il est inutile d'entrer dans plus de détails; ces corps ne voudront pas recevoir du Comité des instructions sur la manière dont ils doivent accomplir leur devoir.
en_html: Therefore, having decided that the Council and the Assembly should vote separately or independently of each other, it was useless to go into further details. These bodies would resent receiving instructions from the Committee as to the method in which they should carry out their duties.
